MESSAGE.value: Refactored `AssetsManager` to enhance asset action handling, updated `Spawn` logic, and adjusted `Scene` asset management.
Renamed & moved a few core folders and a little bit refacatored.
Restructured and renamed documentation files for engine architecture, updated navigation, and adjusted Antora output configuration.
Added new documentation for resource system and module graph, including diagrams, examples, and explanations for `GameInstance` initialization and asset management flow.
Updated engine documentation for lifecycle and resource systems, improved formatting, and fixed inconsistencies in examples and terminology.
Refactored `Actor` to inherit from `WorldObject`, introduced `WorldObject` class, adjusted related methods, and improved code consistency.
Refactored `Actor` to inherit from `IDrawable`, introduced `IDrawable` interface, and updated related methods for improved modularity and reusability.
Refactored `Actor` system to use `WorldObject`, renamed related methods/variables, and improved scene object handling for consistency and clarity.
Refactored `Scene` to use `WorldObject` instead of `Actor`, renamed associated methods/variables, and improved object handling for consistency and clarity.
Refactored `createAndGet` method to return smart pointers, updated usage in `GameInstance`, and improved object handling for safer memory management.
Refactored `Scene` object handling to use smart pointers for improved memory management and consistency; updated related methods and adjusted `GameInstance` logic accordingly.
Refactored `StaticMeshBundle` and `Scene` object handling to improve type safety and object management; updated `AssetsManager` paths for consistency.
Refactored `addToScene` method in `Scene` to improve type safety by introducing explicit cloning and casting logic.

Refactored template constraints to use `std::remove_reference_t` for improved type handling; optimized `BaseComponent` child IO logic; enhanced `Scene` object management and fixed `StaticMeshBundle` rendering logic.
Refactored templates to use `std::remove_reference_t` for improved type safety; modularized `BaseComponent` child-input handling and optimized `Scene` object logic.

Refactored `Scene`, `BaseComponent`, and related classes to enhance type safety with `std::remove_reference_t` usage; streamlined object creation, initialization, and data handling; improved caching and asset management logic in `BaseComponent` and `ECSAsset`.

Refactored `AssetData` to `StreamData` across `StaticMeshBundle`, `BaseComponent`, and related classes for naming consistency and enhanced clarity; introduced `StreamData` structure with centralized definitions; streamlined child component I/O caching logic.

Refactored `WorldObject` to inherit from `NXSceneAsset`, renamed related methods/variables for consistency, unified `Scene` object handling using `BaseComponent` and `ECSAsset`, and streamlined type safety with explicit cloning and data validation logic.

Now, we can add objects to the scene, that was edited (previously) at the ECS Editor. Also, refactored `WorldObject` to inherit from `NXSceneAsset`, adjusted related methods for enhanced asset management; replaced `Actor` inheritance from `WorldObject` with `BaseComponent`; streamlined scene object handling with improved type safety, consistent use of smart pointers, and new `NXSceneAsset` logic; updated documentation accordingly.

Refactored `Misc` module: removed unused dependencies, simplified `JsonAdapter`, restructured `CMakeLists.txt`, and cleaned up redundant code in `Configs`, `JsonCacheable`, and `FPSCounter` for improved clarity and maintainability.
Refactored `Flags.cmake` to remove redundant debug configurations for improved simplicity and clarity.

Integrated FreeType library into ImGui; enabled FreeType support via `IMGUI_ENABLE_FREETYPE`, updated project configurations and dependencies, and adjusted related settings for enhanced font rendering.

Added `ModalAssetsSearchPopUp` to enhance asset selection; updated scene tree logic with component addition functionality; introduced new asset filtering and retrieval methods in `AssetsManager`; optimized `NxECSBasedEditorEWC_Assetseditor` config for simplified component structure and enhanced editor usability.

Refactored `ECSAsset` to use a `Meta` structure for encapsulating metadata; added hashing and equality operators; enhanced `AssetsManager` with static utility methods and weak asset retrieval; standardized method naming and improved code readability.
